summary: Axelera founded in 2010. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding.

insights.one_liner: An Eindhoven start-up building AI chips, now shipping its second chip and openly aiming for a stock market listing within five years.

culture.text: A Dutch company in Eindhoven that designs chips for running AI on devices and, more recently, in data centres.
Roles are hybrid in Eindhoven or Amsterdam, and some can be done remotely from many European countries.

open.text: Axelera AI B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
All 3 current openings here are open to people who don't speak Dutch.

growth.text: It won AI factory supply deals and launched its second-generation chip, Europa.
It more than quadrupled its global partner network in its first year.
Dell and Supermicro have validated the Europa chip in their servers.

worth_knowing.text: Axelera says it is aiming for a US stock market listing within three to five years.
Dutch press calls it a start-up that is winning AI contracts while launching a new chip.
